SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Manage the Kanban stages of each service desk. Stages created here show up on the Tickets board of the matching desk.

SETTINGS.DELETE_BLOCKED_HINT: Move its tickets to another stage before deleting it

MESA.LABEL: Service desk
MESA.LOCKED_HINT: This stage has {count} ticket(s), so it cannot change service desk. Move the tickets first.

ORDER.LABEL: Order
ORDER.HINT: Defines the column position on the board.

STAGE_SLA.LABEL: Stage deadline
STAGE_SLA.HINT: HH:MM. Leave blank for a stage with no deadline.

KIND.LABEL: Stage type
KIND.HINT: Pending and Completed are mandatory and unique per service desk. "Pending" receives tickets generated from a Project. "In progress" is optional: when set, a ticket is moved into it automatically as soon as its linked conversation gets assigned to someone.

HIDDEN.LABEL: Hide this stage from the Kanban board
HIDDEN.HINT: Tickets stay in it normally - only the column doesn't show on the board. Use the detailed search to find them.

AUTOMATION.LABEL: Stage automation
AUTOMATION.HELP: Actions that run on their own whenever a ticket enters this stage.
AUTOMATION.NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: Text that will show up in the ticket's history...

ACTION_HINTS.CLEAR_DUE_DATE: The ticket's due date is cleared.
ACTION_HINTS.CLEAR_SCHEDULED_AT: The ticket's scheduled date is cleared.

CATEGORIES.TITLE: Categories
CATEGORIES.DESCRIPTION: Categories available when opening a ticket in this desk.
CATEGORIES.NAME: Name
CATEGORIES.EMPTY: No category in this desk yet.
CATEGORIES.REQUIRE_ATTACHMENT: Require a file or image when opening
CATEGORIES.REQUIRE_ATTACHMENT_HELP: Anyone opening a ticket in this category must attach at least one file. Applies to agents and to the Client Area.
CATEGORIES.CLIENT_VISIBLE_HELP: Clients pick only the category, never the Mesa. Since the same categories exist in every Mesa, tick only this one so the name is not repeated in their list.

CATALOG.TITLE: Service catalogue
CATALOG.DESCRIPTION: Classification used when closing a ticket, in three levels: Catalogue, Area and Item.
CATALOG.NAME: Name

STAGES.DESCRIPTION: Kanban columns of each service desk.

PRIORITIES.TITLE: Priorities & SLA
PRIORITIES.DESCRIPTION: Response and resolution deadlines for each priority of a service desk.
PRIORITIES.HINT: Use HH:MM, where hours have no ceiling — 30:00 means thirty hours. Leave blank for no deadline.
PRIORITIES.BUSINESS_HOURS: Count deadlines only during business hours

AUTOMATION.TITLE: WhatsApp Automation
AUTOMATION.DESCRIPTION: Settings for the automated WhatsApp triage flow: which client levels the AI tries to resolve on its own, the fallback priority when it fails, and where High priority tickets are routed.

WHATSAPP_FLOW.LABEL: Enable the WhatsApp triage flow
WHATSAPP_FLOW.HELP: When off, incoming WhatsApp conversations are never picked up by the automated flow, regardless of any automation rule configured.

AUTO_ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: WhatsApp auto-assignment
AUTO_ASSIGNMENT.DESCRIPTION: Controls whether new WhatsApp conversations get assigned to an available agent on their own. When off, they still arrive normally, just without automatic assignment - anyone can pick them up manually.

MAX_OPEN_CHATS.LABEL: Open chats limit per agent
MAX_OPEN_CHATS.HELP: An agent who already has this many open WhatsApp conversations stops receiving new ones automatically until they resolve one. Leave blank for no limit.

EXCLUDED_AGENTS.LABEL: Agents excluded from auto-assignment
EXCLUDED_AGENTS.HELP: Checked agents never receive a WhatsApp conversation automatically - they can still be assigned manually as usual.

CSAT_SURVEY.TITLE: WhatsApp satisfaction survey
CSAT_SURVEY.DESCRIPTION: When a WhatsApp conversation is resolved, sends the message below asking the customer to reply with a rating from 1 to 5 (1 = terrible, 5 = great) by typing the number. The rating is recorded in the normal CSAT reports.
CSAT_SURVEY.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: How would you rate our support? Reply with a number from 1 to 5...
CSAT_SURVEY.MESSAGE_HELP: The customer replies by typing just the number (1 to 5) in the WhatsApp conversation itself.
CSAT_SURVEY.MESSAGE_REQUIRED: Write the survey message before saving.

REPLY_WINDOW.LABEL: Window to reply to the survey (minutes)
REPLY_WINDOW.HELP: While the rating hasn't been answered and this time hasn't passed, a new message from the customer reopens the same conversation to record the rating, instead of opening a new conversation and restarting the triage.

TEST_MODE.TITLE: WhatsApp automation test mode
TEST_MODE.DESCRIPTION: With a number set here, the triage flow and Captain only reply automatically to that number. Messages from any other customer still arrive normally in the conversation, they just don't get an automatic reply. Leave it blank to turn this off and go back to normal for everyone.
TEST_MODE.INVALID_NUMBER: Enter a valid number, with "+" and the country code, no spaces (e.g. +15551234567).
TEST_MODE.ACTIVE_WARNING: Test mode is on: only {number} gets an automatic WhatsApp reply right now.

AI_RESOLVE_LEVELS.LABEL: Client levels the AI tries to resolve on its own
AI_RESOLVE_LEVELS.HELP: Levels not selected here only get triaged by the AI and handed off to a human - never a full resolution attempt.

DEFAULT_PRIORITY.LABEL: Default priority if the AI classification fails
DEFAULT_PRIORITY.HELP: Used only when the triage step's classification call fails or returns something invalid - the flow never stalls waiting on it.

OPEN_TICKET_WINDOW.LABEL: Consider a ticket "open" for how many days
OPEN_TICKET_WINDOW.HELP: Leave blank to reuse any open ticket regardless of age (current behavior). With a value, an older open ticket is treated as stale and a new one is created instead.

PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.TITLE: Client priority by monthly fee
PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.DESCRIPTION: Set the monthly fee amounts at which a client becomes Medium and High priority. Below the first value, the client is automatically Low priority - no need to configure it per client.
PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.INVALID_RANGE: The High priority amount must be greater than the Medium priority amount.
PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.RECALCULATE_HELP: Recalculates the priority of every existing client using the amounts above (saves the settings automatically first).
PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.RECALCULATE_STARTED: Recalculation started - this can take a few minutes depending on how many clients you have.
PRIORITY_THRESHOLDS.RECALCULATE_ERROR: Could not start the recalculation. Please try again.

LEVEL_3TO5_TEAM.LABEL: Service desk for High priority clients
LEVEL_3TO5_TEAM.HELP: Where the conversation is routed once the AI finishes triaging a High priority client.

SUPPORT_PHONE.LABEL: Support phone number
SUPPORT_PHONE.HELP: Shown to the customer when the company isn't enabled for support on this channel.

QUEUE_LOW.LABEL: Queue for Low/Medium priority
QUEUE_LOW.HELP: Where the conversation goes when the AI classifies priority as Low or Medium.

QUEUE_HIGH.LABEL: Queue for High/Urgent priority
QUEUE_HIGH.HELP: Where the conversation goes when the AI classifies priority as High (or an agent marks it Urgent).

DEFAULT_QUEUE.LABEL: Default queue (fallback)
DEFAULT_QUEUE.HELP: Only used when the priority queue above isn't set. If both of those are filled in, this one is not used by the AI triage.

API.ERROR: Could not update the automation settings.

ATTENDANCE_SCHEDULE.TITLE: Attendance Schedule
ATTENDANCE_SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Sets which days and hours the automated triage can start. Outside that window, the customer gets an offline notice and the conversation drops into the queue to wait for the next attendance window.

ENABLED.LABEL: Attendance schedule active
ENABLED.HELP: When on, messages outside the periods below never start the automated triage - they only get the offline notice.

OFFLINE_MESSAGE.LABEL: Offline message
OFFLINE_MESSAGE.HELP: Sent to the customer when they write outside the configured schedule.
OFFLINE_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: We're currently outside our attendance hours...
OFFLINE_MESSAGE.REQUIRED: Required while the attendance schedule is active.

WINDOW.TITLE: Days and hours
WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Add as many periods as you need per day - for example, a normal morning/afternoon shift plus a weekend on-call period in the evening.
WINDOW.INVALID_RANGE: Each period needs an end time after its start time.

API.ERROR: Could not update the attendance schedule.
API.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the periods already configured.

IMPORT.TITLE: Import tickets
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: Import tickets from another system from a CSV spreadsheet.

FIELDS.TITLE: Spreadsheet template
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION: Download the template below to see the exact expected format, with a filled-in example. Desk, Stage and Category need to already exist with those names (Category is created automatically if missing).

IMPORT.FILE_HINT: The import runs in the background - spreadsheets with tens of thousands of rows work fine, they just take longer. Fully empty rows (common in CSVs saved by Excel) are ignored automatically.
